description: This file contains an extension for the CanvasWindowController class, implementing WKNavigationDelegate methods to handle web view navigation actions, including deep link handling, URL scheme filtering, and external application opening.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: A controller managing a window with embedded web content, extended here to handle specific navigation actions.

methods.name: webView(decidePolicyFor:decisionHandler:)
methods.description: Decides whether to allow or cancel navigation actions based on URL schemes, handling deep links, internal content, and external URLs.

methods.name: webView(didFinish:)
methods.description: Called when web view finishes navigation, triggers UI or debug updates.
